_scope: Pathfinder grapple, R5Flowstate S21 client / S3 dedi, 120 fps; M4b swing sessions + M4 pathfinder sessions; values computed by swing_analysis.py. Anchor = aim-ray hit from origin + 60 (eye assumed).

pull.horizontal_direction.value: toward the aim-ray hit point (world-fixed anchor)
pull.horizontal_direction.source: horizontal accel azimuth - rope azimuth, M4b side+jump (deg)

pull.anchor_y_from_accel_lines_minus_aim.source: intersection of horizontal accel lines with the face

pull.path_lateral_max.source: max deviation from the start->anchor line

pull.tangential_speed_after_burst_max.source: relative to the aim-ray anchor (eye 60 assumed)

pull.speed_ramp.source: d|v|/dt > 150 u from the anchor, M4b side+jump

steer.view_turn_no_W.heading_change_at_r.source: turn(+turn_jump) minus side(+jump); view turned ~54 deg right

steer.view_turn_no_W.a_lat_turning.source: horizontal accel perpendicular to the rope while turning

steer.W.a_along_view.source: turn_w, accel along the flat view forward

steer.W.vh_max.source: turn_w: v_h exceeds 483 (M4 cap not general)

detach.rule.source: no single-feature threshold (gap, 3D/2D anchor distance, time-to-face/anchor, fraction of rope length, pull time, speed, angle) separates released and pulled cmds over all trials

detach.gap_envelope_noW.source: origin gap to the face, first released cmd

detach.gap_at_contact_W_turn.source: turn_w: never released, still pulled on the impact cmd

release.boost.source: first released cmd is ballistic; velocity continuous

release.jump_effect.source: max |dv| jump vs side after the press (baseline side vs side 1.581)
release.jump_effect.note: jump does not release the grapple during the pull

envelope.speed_law_noinput.source: |v| = v0 + A t since pull start, pooled no-input pulled cmds (t >= 0.1 s), rms 24.35 u/s, n 7723
